what: On an accent-color curtain, in a 150px stage at the center, a logo graphic and a character graphic appear alternately at a 1-second tempo. After the logo, one of the characters is picked at random and pops up from transparent, 50% of its height below, flattened to 1.2/.8 (-10% → 5% flattened again → in place, .6s cubic-bezier(.33,1,.68,1)) and stands. On the next beat the logo returns (turns on in .6s). Even after the window finishes loading, both beats are completed and one more beat rests, then the curtain lifts in 1s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) and emits is-done and fx:done

options.loops: Number of slots to fill even after loading, default 2

use: Welcome To

from.where: index.html .ll-opening — original #opening (.p-opening__image logo + 5 characters, 1000ms beat, neededLoopedTimes 2, 1000ms after window.onload body._loaded → cover opacity 1s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1))
